text: The Board recommends the appointment of one candidate, Hamdi Abdo, who is temporarily living outside of the catchment area due to extenuating circumstances. The Board further confirms that each of these nominees is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint these nominated candidates. The Board also wishes to confirm that the following members, previously appointed by Community Council, continue to serve on the Board for the terms of office noted below and until successors are appointed: - Eadit Rokach, for a term of office ending March 31, 2022 - Jim Valentine, for a term of office ending March 31, 2022 - Tim McNabb, for a term of office ending March 31, 2022 - Vai Teng…

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following five candidates for appointment to the Applegrove Community Complex Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending March 31, 2023, and until successors are appointed: Andre Riolo Hamdi Abdo Jean Lim O'Brien Simone Hodgson Susan Munn
